name: Interpersonal Behavior and Team Dynamics
description: This course will help students understand the nature and characteristics of teams, differences across team types, and key elements impacting team dynamics such as group identity, norms, trust, psychological safety, power, leadership, and conflict. Students will learn to identify and manage dysfunctional team behaviors and build effective teams. This course will draw upon research driven knowledge to understand and implement effective strategies for developing effective teams. The course will integrate reflections on contemporary issues at work and industry relevant examples for how these are managed.
